    CONNECTING FOLK ACROSS CANADA
    BRINGING CANADIAN FOLK TO THE WORLD

    WHAT IS
    FOLK CANADA?

    Folk Canada is the nation’s leading organization dedicated to the folk, roots, and traditional music community, with over 38 years of supporting our members and the growth of the Canadian folk music industry. Our initiatives include the annual Folk Canada Conference, Developing Artist Program, Developing Presenters' Program, Festivals' Retreat, Ontario Folk Music Awards, Refolkus Podcast, International export events, and more. 

    ABOUT US

    WHAT IS
    FOLK ?

    At Folk Canada we think of 'Folk' as being made by the people for the people; informed by cultural traditions, guided by a shared set of social priorities, and carving new and innovative pathways through its connection to the global roots of music, storytelling, and folklore.


    At the 2025 Folk Music Ontario Conference, 13+ languages were represented in song, by artists that ranged from Hip Hop, Chamber Music, Electronica, Singer/Songwriter, Rock, Bluegrass, Swing, and so much more, all sharing a common grounding in cultural creativity and connection.

    BECOME A MEMBER

    Join Canada’s largest organization dedicated to the folk, roots, and traditional music, and help us to support and strengthen our community year-round.

     

    Our members enjoy savings on conference registration, showcase applications, award submissions, access to our Festivals’ Retreat, partner event discounts, access to our member directory and message boards, plus opportunities to promote your events and releases through our Member Promotion Program.

    Showcase Applications are now open for the 2026 Folk Canada Conference (Formerly the Folk Music Ontario Conference), taking place October 14-18, 2026 in Hamilton, Ontario! Deadline to Apply: January 30, 2026 Click here to apply now Click here to read the FAQ We're getting out applications earlier than ever this year!
